Dimple Creation Surgery in Bangalore with Face-Specific Placement

Dimple creation, or dimpleplasty, is a minor surgical procedure designed to create a small indentation in the cheek that becomes more visible during smiling. The position, depth and number of dimples are planned around facial proportions and the patient's preferred appearance. A natural-looking result depends on conservative placement, so NeoSculpt6 considers cheek thickness, smile pattern and symmetry before surgery rather than treating dimples as a one-size-fits-all mark.

What Is DIMPLE CREATION SURGERY?

Dimple creation, or dimpleplasty, is a minor surgical procedure that creates a controlled connection between the inner cheek tissue and the skin so an indentation appears during smiling. The proposed position is marked according to facial proportions and smile movement, and the procedure is usually performed through a small opening inside the mouth under local anaesthesia in suitable patients.

A suture or controlled tissue attachment creates the dimple effect without an external skin incision. Early dimples can look deeper or remain visible at rest before swelling and internal fixation soften, so the initial result should not be treated as the final contour.

Choose the Position and Depth Before the Procedure

The surgeon assesses facial symmetry, smile movement, cheek thickness and where a dimple would appear most natural. You can discuss one-sided or bilateral dimples and whether you prefer a subtle or more visible effect.

The consultation also covers temporary swelling, bruising, mouth care, eating restrictions and the fact that a new dimple can appear more prominent at rest during early healing before it settles.

OUR PROCESS

OUR DIMPLE CREATION PROCESS

The surgeon evaluates cheek thickness, facial symmetry and smile movement, and discusses the preferred location, number of dimples and desired visibility.

The proposed position is marked and reviewed with the patient while the face is relaxed and smiling, with depth and symmetry expectations agreed.

Local anaesthesia numbs the cheek and the intraoral area is prepared with sterile technique, so the procedure can be done through the mouth without an external incision in suitable cases.

A controlled internal tissue attachment is created at the marked location, with enough definition without making the indentation unnecessarily deep or rigid.

Patients receive guidance on mouth rinsing, food texture, oral hygiene and avoiding trauma to the cheek, since the surgical site is inside the mouth.

Follow-up checks swelling, oral healing, symmetry and how the dimple is changing as the fixation settles.

WHO CAN BENEFIT FROM DIMPLE CREATION?

  • Adults Seeking a Subtle Cheek Dimple

    Adults who want a subtle cheek dimple may be considered when they understand the elective nature of the procedure and the limits of symmetry. One or two dimples can be planned according to facial anatomy, smile pattern and preferred definition.

  • Patients Seeking Greater Smile Definition

    Dimple creation can add a localised indentation for a stronger smile feature, but it does not reshape the cheekbone, jawline or overall facial proportions.

  • Patients with Realistic Symmetry Expectations

    Natural faces are not perfectly symmetrical and the two cheeks can heal differently; the goal is balanced placement and a natural smile effect. Active oral infection, poor wound healing, uncontrolled medical conditions or unrealistic expectations may make elective surgery inappropriate.

Dimple Creation Surgery is planned around facial anatomy, surgical precision, recovery and natural-looking results.

Dimple Creation Surgery Cost and Consultation in Bangalore

Cost depends on whether one or both cheeks are treated, surgical complexity, anaesthesia and follow-up.

  1. 01

    Single vs Bilateral Dimple

    Treating one cheek or both involves different amounts of marking, tissue work and procedure time.

  2. 02

    Facial Anatomy

    Cheek thickness, facial asymmetry and any previous surgery or scar tissue can change the technical plan.

  3. 03

    Anaesthesia and Facility

    The written estimate should explain what is included for the procedure, anaesthesia, facility use and planned postoperative care.

  4. 04

    Follow-Up

    The quotation should clarify planned review visits and how additional care would be handled if healing is slower.

FAQs About Dimple Creation Surgery

The result is intended to be long-lasting, but depth and visibility can change with healing, ageing and facial movement.
